status: proposed forward protocol; no live orders or external preregistration
overlay_action: remove only; removed weight remains cash
overlay_evidence_cutoff: prior trading-session close with source availability verified
overlay_flow_rule: positive qualifying bullish-minus-bearish premium over five official sessions ending at the prior-session cutoff; proposed, not historically validated
entry: submit closing orders before the broker-confirmed cutoff; reference execution is the close
exit: next executable opening print; no premarket substitution in this backtest
missing_exit: retain position; block all new entries until exit is executable
H1: Positive net return after observed execution costs at session 252; negative estimate or risk suspension rejects the operating plan.
H2: Positive paired daily overlay-minus-mechanical return; report exposure-matched control separately to distinguish selection from additional cash.
reported_costs: 20 bp per side assignment case and observed execution case shown separately
